name: QG-I1392: Resending an expired contract retires the old version and sends a new one with a new expiry
description:
Objective: QG-I1392: Resending an expired contract retires the old version and sends a new one with a new expiry.
Preconditions: Open Bug regressions contract with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Bug regressions contract.
2. QG-I1392: Resending an expired contract retires the old version and sends a new one with a new expiry.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Runs on the user-designated expired application (CONTRACT_EXPIRED_URL, APP-2026-000100). While its contract is expired the test resends it (approved by the user on 24 Nov 2026); once resent, later runs verify that resend until the new contract expires again.
